title: Google rolls back AI image generation inside Google Earth after one day
friendlyTitle: Google removes its new AI image tool from Google Earth
summary: Google removed a feature that let people place Nano Banana-generated imagery over Google Earth scenes one day after launch. The company said screenshots appeared to violate its policies and that the feature would remain rolled back while stronger guardrails are developed.
friendlySummary: The tool let people add made-up AI images to Google Earth scenes. Google removed it after one day because shared screenshots could mislead people and break its rules.
whyItMatters: Mixing generated scenes with a widely trusted mapping interface creates a provenance problem even when the feature is intended for creativity. Product teams should design visible labels, export controls and abuse testing before placing generative tools inside evidence-like interfaces.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Creative AI needs extra care inside apps people trust as evidence. Clear labels and strong sharing controls should be built before launch, not added after problems appear.
